REPORT zselection_screen_events.
TABLES sscrfields.
PARAMETERS p_main TYPE c LENGTH 1.
SELECTION-SCREEN FUNCTION KEY 1.
SELECTION-SCREEN FUNCTION KEY 2.
SELECTION-SCREEN BEGIN OF TABBED BLOCK tabs FOR 5 LINES.
SELECTION-SCREEN TAB (20) tab1 USER-COMMAND tab1 DEFAULT SCREEN 101.
SELECTION-SCREEN TAB (20) tab2 USER-COMMAND tab2 DEFAULT SCREEN 102.
SELECTION-SCREEN END OF BLOCK tabs.
SELECTION-SCREEN BEGIN OF SCREEN 101 AS SUBSCREEN.
PARAMETERS p_one TYPE c LENGTH 1.
SELECTION-SCREEN END OF SCREEN 101.
SELECTION-SCREEN BEGIN OF SCREEN 102 AS SUBSCREEN.
PARAMETERS p_two TYPE c LENGTH 1.
SELECTION-SCREEN END OF SCREEN 102.

AT SELECTION-SCREEN OUTPUT.
  PERFORM output.
AT SELECTION-SCREEN ON p_main.
  MESSAGE |FIELD:{ sy-dynnr }:P_MAIN| TYPE 'S'.
AT SELECTION-SCREEN ON p_one.
  MESSAGE |FIELD:{ sy-dynnr }:P_ONE| TYPE 'S'.
AT SELECTION-SCREEN ON p_two.
  IF sy-dynnr <> '0102'.
    MESSAGE 'Inactive field was checked' TYPE 'E'.
  ENDIF.
  MESSAGE |FIELD:{ sy-dynnr }:P_TWO| TYPE 'S'.
AT SELECTION-SCREEN.
  PERFORM input.
  IF sy-dynnr = '1000' AND sy-ucomm = 'FC01'.
    MESSAGE 'BUTTON:FC01' TYPE 'S'.
  ENDIF.

FORM output.
  MESSAGE |PBO:{ sy-dynnr }| TYPE 'S'.
  IF sy-dynnr = '1000'.
    sscrfields-functxt_01 = 'Main action 1'.
    sscrfields-functxt_02 = 'Main action 2'.
  ENDIF.
  LOOP AT SCREEN.
    IF sy-dynnr = '0101' AND screen-name = 'P_ONE'.
      screen-active = '0'.
    ENDIF.
    MODIFY SCREEN.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.
FORM input.
  MESSAGE |PAI:{ sy-dynnr }| TYPE 'S'.
ENDFORM.
